body:
HIDDEN COUPLING / HARD CONSTRAINTS (report refs):
A. `docs/PWA-구현-최적화-연구보고서.md:15,125-145`: two registrable domains conflicts with the smooth launcher-role-swap. A private-origin launcher cannot become a compliant public Stage; navigating it cross-origin loses the fullscreen activation. Gate the UX fork now.
B. `:158-187`: mirror bootstrap says PC has AudienceDisplaySession only, but pairing requires an existing Console approval. Make phone-first session ownership/display binding, or pair before mirroring with a verified credential/cache purge runbook.
C. `:73,83,292-308`: one Session Service serving both roles conflicts with the data-diode claim. Use private authority + explicit public projection gateway/store and separate credentials/topics. Display receipts/health are a closed public-to-private schema, so the invariant is content noninterference, not literal one-way networking.
D. Deck artifact is itself cross-boundary. Canonical ingestion must output separate immutable `PrivateDeckContext` (notes/extracted internal text) and `PublishedDeckArtifact` (audience-approved render/manifest). Public Stage must not fetch the private canonical bundle.
E. Offline public caching conflicts with revocation/confidential deck handling (`:379-395`). An offline cached deck cannot be remotely revoked. Decide deck classification: only `PUBLIC_CACHEABLE` decks get Stage precache; sensitive decks are memory/online-only and fail readiness without a separately accepted emergency export.
F. WSS authority is underspecified (`:202-222`): viewer emits slide events, controller sends commands, Stage sends applied receipts. Server revision is canonical; controller proposes absolute intent; Stage only applies projection and receipts. During cloud loss either Stage gets an explicit emergency-local-controller transition (audited/reconciled) or “local presentation continues” is false for mirrored remote control.
G. Supabase Realtime may relay notifications but does not itself prove idempotency, controller leases, atomic epochs, durable snapshots, or bounded slow-consumer behavior. Select a coordinator after a restart/fault spike; Postgres/DO/session service is authority, Realtime only wakeup if retained.
H. STT/slide fusion must join by capture-time slide revision history, never processing-time `currentSlide`. Finals commonly arrive after a slide change. Utterances spanning revisions must split or become AMBIGUOUS (no auto recommendation).
I. Candidate publication needs a causal envelope: deckVersion+manifestHash, slideRevision, transcriptFinalId, source hashes, ACL/policy versions, rights/DLP decision. Partial-STT prewarm is cancelable speculation and cannot promote without a matching final.
J. Expanded and mirrored modes should differ only in bootstrap/topology. After role registration they must use the same command/projection protocol; mode-specific business state will fork correctness and test matrices.
summary: Hidden coupling map and hard contradictions
